O01.title: 单一持久业务字段与已核快照绑定
O01.consumer: Actual CLI history replay, workbook show/verify and Work loading.
O01.event: After a genuine commit, change one business fact while retaining canonical closure and independently recorded original.
variants: Approved historical status: reuse existing supplemental-status producer and canonical cancelled status, directly executing runtime service1177 deletion.
Workbook response flows single invalid FlowId, audit work ownership/revision, publication request/index identity: assert trusted original qualification and cause, not only code.

UUID/current-owner corruption: retain canonical pending path shape except UUID and legitimate owner bytes, account for earlier Work publication validation; where an earlier row already validated FX, use one exact metadata-to-full-row temporary observation so the changed BLOB reaches this branch.

Payload manifest identity: keep expected id/version from committed audit/snapshot/row; change only actual manifest id or version and recalculate the independent real digest consistently in snapshot/effect/Store fields. The sole mismatching identity condition must reach intended parse/load guard, rather than fail earlier digest check.
Metadata check_row no-op: same exact narrow/full-row observation changes one narrow metadata field; assert no trusted original from the later unmatched reply.
O01.instrumentation: Only for narrow-metadata/full-effects reread or frozen/private-copy identity gap not already observable: add identical temporary observation to baseline and each relevant mutant. Save initial and changed SQL plus original independently. Existing status and snapshot producer needs no new observation.
O01.why_shared: One SQL fixture producer and recorded original supports all fields without a per-expression expected value.

O03.title: 新根、现有锁与原生错误保真
O03.consumer: Actual Home acquire lock/concurrent schema initialization/Store read.
O03.event: Existing trusted root or file observed, then one native permission/type/link/inode condition changes at exact stat/open or metadata step.
variants: Completely absent nested Home root: legal self install creates it; traverse_root create_missing=false fails.
Read-only sees schema incomplete during legitimate initializer while existing HomeLock held: retry must wait and return actual schema result; false/!= guard fails prematurely.
Root search permission revoked after root handle open, before lock stat or Store metadata: original retains native non-NotFound IO; unconditional NOENT guard wrongly returns absent/NotFound.

Lock regular kind/link validation and observed/opened dev/inode mismatch: a same-volume changed inode is reachable; device-only cases need real backend/mount feasibility proof, not fake fstat or host assumptions.
Home lock setup non-NotFound IO must not be misclassified as disappeared root retry.
O03.instrumentation: Reuse directory_open_after_open/home_existing_lock_opened/store_before_sqlite_open when they precede exact operation. Inner lock stat/open or metadata-error window requires same temporary controlled observation; source baseline must actually exhibit expected native error.
O03.why_shared: One controlled local filesystem fixture with precise event choice distinguishes native errors and locks without introducing arbitrary public APIs.

O04.title: 文件/目录stat到open对象一致性
O04.consumer: ManagedDir writes, ensure_dirs, atomic history, ExternalReadTree and recursive mode/delete callers.
O04.event: Keep observed inode, replace path with a symlink alias of that same inode after stat before open; or replace directory with ordinary file when DIRECTORY is removed.
variants: Read regular-file branch with external_tree_after_stat already exists; same-inode alias is necessary so later inode compare does not mask NOFOLLOW loss.
Ensure directory/create/recursive chmod/delete each share the same stat/open observation shape; retain independent external sentinel bytes/mode.

EXCL+CREATE write branch with NOFOLLOW+CLOEXEC removed still refuses a preexisting symlink via EXCL; do not claim detection by that fixture. CLOEXEC requires an actual current exec consumer while FD is held or narrowly justified no-producer proof.
Evaluate Rust & precedence as adjacent disjoint flag-pair removal, not whole mask zero.
O04.instrumentation: Recursive inner stat/open lacks current exact observer: one instrumentation helper pattern inserted at each selected real branch, identical baseline/mutant and with separate event-site closure. No trait/mock/syscall fabrication.
O04.why_shared: Same-inode alias and ordinary-file replacement provide two real OS cases for many flag expressions; retain masks whose only changed observation is exec inheritance separately.

O05.title: 同FD、来源与移动/封存后的路径绑定
O05.consumer: Actual published tree rename/verify, binary rollback exchange, seal and owner/marker cleanup.
O05.event: After holding original object, change only current path kind/link/inode or held file size at precisely selected pre/post operation boundary.
variants: Tree verify/rename: regular-file or different-directory path while held tree remains original; baseline rejects before/after rename, mutation may proceed and alter endpoint.
After binary EXCHANGE: move/hardlink target before endpoint stat; original RecoveryRequired preserves both endpoints; mutation can miss target nlink/dev/inode change.

Seal before hash: grow held output after committed independent SHA/bytes but before verify_seal_reference; record early error vs additional reads/hash, not equivalent just because later bounded read rejects.

Owner provenance: read_owner_file uses unlocked open_managed_regular. Root temporarily swapped at owner open then restored, owner inode migrated into original root; origin.root_ident differs while rel and actual final inode agree. The provenance OR->AND must remain open, not be assumed all false from deletion-time check_lock.

Delete marker post-sync bound check: existing delete_marker_after_validation_before_sync is too early to isolate final verifier because sync_regular_file_handle_locked itself rechecks path; the exact after-sync/before-final-bound interval needs a same temporary observation.
O05.instrumentation: One shared retained-object mutation fixture, selected branch events saved separately. Same-FD device/inode immutable facts can be proved only when both observations are on exactly the same owned FD; path stat/open comparisons cannot inherit that proof.
O05.why_shared: Independent held inode and initial bytes/mode are the oracle; varies physical event instead of mirroring Boolean guard.

O06.title: 发布/删除四格终态与最终rescan
O06.consumer: Start/Add publish, Remove/marker recovery, readonly locate, purge finish.
O06.event: Create or remove exactly one pending/final/root entry between successful step and final re-observation.
variants: After publish tree sync/rename before final-state verification: reappear pending or remove/replace final; original never marks completed for illegal terminal state.
After delete tree removed before marker, then separately after marker synced before final check: one foreign pending/final directory reappears, sentinel retained and published remains0.
Readonly locate pending+final both present and neither present are canonical four-state negatives; no tuple derived from mutated condition.

Purge last final rescan: create unknown root entry after the third extras scan but before final remaining listing. The earlier rescan catches normal late controls; final guard=true only distinguishable in this exact last gap.
O06.instrumentation: Existing publish_after_tree_sync can isolate before-rename family but not all post-rename final checks. Reuse existing marker/delete failpoint facts; choose temporary live rendezvous at exact missing post-step event if needed. Same instrumentation closure required.
O06.why_shared: One real pending/final truth table and independent registered tree/marker identity covers terminal predicates.

O07.event: Inject one actual supported failure/control transition at chosen I/O boundary, then verify own inode removed or foreign inode preserved and recorded warnings.
variants: Ownerless container/marker and legal orphan: whole reference index validated before removing any path; warnings and residue are independent file facts.
Missing pending root with published versus unpublished reference must warn only unfinished reference.

O07.why_shared: One legal-orphan/unknown-owner/write-failure fixture distinguishes cleanup safety, warning truth and durability obligations.

O08.title: 同一发布清单的array与fallback checksum
O08.consumer: Actual local self update dry-run or controlled transport and independently hashed asset.
O08.event: Keep real archive/platform/tag fixed; alternate canonical cargo-dist artifacts array and only fallback raw checksum field.
variants: Legal array artifacts and lowercase64hex checksum select correct independently SHA-verified asset.
Malformed length with otherwisehex string and exact64length with nonhex string are two single-condition negatives; asset not transported before rejection.
Later digest failure is not equivalent to early manifest omission if lookup/download IO differs.
O08.instrumentation: No source instrumentation; existing local release fixture and actual CLI suffice.
O08.why_shared: Three small manifest variants target all current three cargo-dist survivors, no large subprocess-limit fixture.

O09.title: schema/CAS/SQLite错误分类
O09.consumer: Actual readonly Store initialization check and transaction update/Workbook insert.
O09.event: A otherwise valid schema2 table has one constraint/default altered; an existing Work has revision0; a Workbook insertion gets genuine non-constraint SQLite failure.
variants: Whitespace-only CREATE differences accepted; one changed constraint rejected by original strict schema regardless table names/columns.
Revision0 must STORE_CORRUPT before CAS/write; >= mutation may derive legal0 and change subsequent behavior.
Non-ConstraintViolation insertion failure must stay SQLite/IO, not WorkbookExists. A fixture using a constraint failure cannot distinguish unconditional guard=true.
O09.instrumentation: No source instrumentation for schema/revision. Use supported local SQLite table/trigger/error producer for genuine non-constraint code if reachable; otherwise leave that error-domain obligation open, not fabricate rusqlite error as a product result.
O09.why_shared: Small existing temporary Store fixtures, no large workbook tree or workspace rerun.
